body:
I acquired some .5mg Lorazepam and 50mg Tramadol from a family member who didn't use them anymore, and decided to explore the psychoactive properties when they were used together.
6pm: Ingested 4 50mg Tramadol and 2 .5mg Ativan(Lorazepam)
7pm: Noticed a slight intoxication
8pm: Watching a movie, laying in bed, feel the need to wrap myself in a blanket and become as warm as possible, dose off for 20 mins, and upon awakening, finish my movie
1030pm: Walking around my apartment, cannot feel my legs, I feel as if I am floating, very similar to a Hydrocodone trip. I can barely this this report
All in all, I think that I got a good trip out of the work required to obtain the pills.
